mechanism: Varenicline (nicotinic partial agonist) and scopolamine (anticholinergic) have opposing effects on cholinergic neurotransmission, potentially reducing efficacy of varenicline for smoking cessation and increasing anticholinergic adverse effects.
action: Monitor for reduced varenicline efficacy and increased anticholinergic effects (dry mouth, urinary retention, cognitive impairment); consider alternative anticholinergic agents if possible or dose adjustment of varenicline.
